broader_motivation: Resolve Erdős–Straus and develop exact structural connections to other mathematics, preserving the original arithmetic rather than replacing it by a restricted selector.
motivation_provenance: The broader aim was directly expressed by the owner. Route-specific heuristic reasons are editorial reconstructions from the cited constructions, not verbatim accounts of historical intent.
coverage: Five routes in the published supplement; not every historical task or neighbouring workbench.

attempts.title: Full-shell occupancy and factor sieves
attempts.aim: Determine exactly what an ES counterexample must evade.
attempts.heuristic_reason: Bounded prime-factor exponents retain information discarded by a coarse congruence sieve.
attempts.tried: Full divisor packets, ordered witness reconstruction and exact factor tests for residuals three and seven.
attempts.outcome: Exact first-two-shell tests and a necessary-and-sufficient all-shell no-hit criterion at each input prime; explicit per-shell selector failures.
attempts.successful_scope: The original full finite prime-shell system, with complete fibres; the first-two-shell criterion concerns those shells only.
attempts.unfinished: No proof that some shell is occupied for every prime, and no prime with all shells empty.

attempts.title: Simultaneous constraints and bounded CRT
attempts.aim: Express the colleague's linked conditions on one exact permitted integer tuple.
attempts.heuristic_reason: CRT can organize congruences if shared variables and their original bounds survive the local-to-global passage.
attempts.tried: Lattice gluing, bounded divisor CRT, Boolean coordinates and bounded input/prime-output incidence.
attempts.outcome: Complete finite fibre algorithms and witness return; exact examples of integral and finite-budget obstructions.
attempts.successful_scope: All solutions in the specified original finite domains, with their exact input/output projections.
attempts.unfinished: Integral compatibility does not by itself give bounded occupancy; the prime-output construction has no asserted surjectivity.

attempts.title: Witness propagation and exact first codes
attempts.aim: Propagate solutions with their order, raw factor scale and original codes retained.
attempts.heuristic_reason: A transport law can connect witnesses across shells or primes without restarting their construction.
attempts.tried: Ratio maps, positive shears, fixed-denominator successors, ray returns and four swap/tag candidates.
attempts.outcome: Complete integer domains, inverse maps and failed returns; a global first code on the occupied residual-three domain.
attempts.successful_scope: Each explicitly classified transport domain; the residual-three first-code theorem applies when that shell is occupied.
attempts.unfinished: The classified domains do not yet force universal occupancy. Two passing adjacent positive shears cannot compose.

attempts.title: Divisor categories and cyclic coordinates
attempts.aim: Construct exact Connes–Consani interfaces for the retained arithmetic.
attempts.heuristic_reason: Embedded ordered groups retain finite divisor data, and integral cyclic characters can detect gluing obstructions.
attempts.tried: Embedded intersections, reciprocal returns, primitive marks, affine shear correction and cyclic-character coordinates.
attempts.outcome: Exact maps with arithmetic return; a stronger corrected map where the uncorrected map fails.
attempts.successful_scope: The specified finite divisor loci, transport domains and integral exponent-gluing obstruction.
attempts.unfinished: Zero integral obstruction still does not force occupancy of the original bounded fibre.

attempts.title: Auxiliary torus, sampling and directional inverse
attempts.aim: Transport arithmetic character packets through the cited auxiliary cover and return the analysis to its operators.
attempts.heuristic_reason: Exact finite covering fibres determine what averaging and sampling preserve.
attempts.tried: Unchanged-grid sampling, complete-preimage and character-coset repair, continuous transfer and directional inverse estimates.
attempts.outcome: Explicit extra sampling terms, exact repairs preserving packet counts, and sharp directional inverse estimates.
attempts.successful_scope: The retained arithmetic packets and the specified finite or continuous operator domains, with full constants and fibres.
attempts.unfinished: No construction of a fluid solution from a prime, universal ES occupancy or complete fluid proof verification follows here.
